# Cully 0.27.0

Cully standardizes its terminal UI on native macOS and Linux terminals with zsh + Oh My Zsh.

- Run `cully setup --terminal-only` to install the required shell environment and Nerd Font preset automatically. Existing shell/font settings are backed up, with restore instructions.
- Select MesloLGS Nerd Font Mono at 14 pt on macOS or 12 pt on Linux so home, folder and Git icons have the glyphs they need.
- Verify icons/Unicode and colors with `u` and `c` in the live exercise, then test wheel, divider and advisor gestures. Incomplete checks remain unverified; headless setup does not claim visual success.
- Preserve normal-screen history, fullscreen agents' own wheel handling, SGR/legacy reports and keyboard/mouse event order. Page Up/Down provide keyboard access to normal-screen history.
- Drop Warp-specific settings, scrollbar and input workarounds. Use macOS Terminal or a supported GNOME terminal on Linux. Other shells and third-party terminals are outside support.
- Switch between named sessions in one window with the new left sidebar: click **+ New**, click a name to switch, or **Rename**. Each session keeps its own agent, input and scroll position and ends with the window.
- Cully now activates only through `cully run`. Running `claude`, `codex` or `cursor-agent` directly stays native: no hooks, guidance or skills are visible to them. Cully no longer installs a status line; the Cully panel is the one display.
- Native keys, including modified arrows such as Shift+Right, pass through to the agent whole. Cully shortcuts are opt-in with `CULLY_SHORTCUTS=1`.
- Windows is no longer supported; Cully targets macOS and Linux.

Restart existing Cully sessions after updating. Model/token/tool statistics require real agent signals and are not inferred from the terminal exercise.
